assessment: The source changes only Kolla's Rocky Linux 9 and CentOS Stream 9 Ceph repositories from Reef to Squid. All four failure arms stop earlier while setup_gate.sh installs the Kolla source into a fresh virtual environment: the old pip invokes setup.py metadata generation, pbr 7.1.1 imports tomli, and installation fails because neither tomli nor setuptools.extern.tomli is available. The target independently upgrades pip before installing Kolla and therefore repairs this packaging-environment failure. The same failure can occur for an unchanged Kolla checkout whenever the newly resolved pbr meets the old pip/setuptools environment, so it is not caused by the Ceph repository diff.

source_patch: replace centos-ceph-reef with centos-ceph-squid in repository configuration and matching tests
target_patch: upgrade pip in the fresh kolla virtual environment before installing Kolla
